tools.name: reminder_add
tools.description: Add a reminder that wakes the conversation when it comes due. Give either in_minutes or at, not both.

text.description: What to be reminded of, in the user's own words.

at.description: Absolute time in ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, e.g. 2026-10-27T18:30:00+08:00.

repeat_minutes.description: Repeat every N minutes after it comes due until handled; omit to remind once.

summary.zh: 记一条提醒,到点由 World 主动唤醒会话。
summary.en: Record a reminder that wakes the conversation when due.

tools.name: reminder_list
tools.description: List the open reminders in due order, with their times and remaining time.

include_closed.description: Also list the most recent finished or cancelled reminders.

summary.zh: 按时间顺序列出待提醒。
summary.en: List open reminders in due order.

tools.name: reminder_done
tools.description: Mark one reminder as handled, so it stops repeating.

summary.zh: 把一条提醒标成已处理。

tools.name: reminder_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one open reminder without marking it as handled.

tools.name: reminder_snooze
tools.description: Push one open reminder further out by N minutes and clear its fired count.

minutes.description: How many minutes to push it out, 1 to 10080.

summary.zh: 把一条提醒往后推若干分钟。

description.zh: World 挂载完成,附带待提醒条数。
description.en: The World was mounted, with the number of open reminders.

description.zh: 一条提醒到点、预告或需要重复提醒。
description.en: A reminder came due, is due soon, or needs repeating.

prompts.title: 提醒 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
这是一个本地提醒 World:待办存在本机,到点由它主动推事件叫你,不需要轮询。
当前时间 {{reminder.now}};{{reminder.summary}};下一条是 {{reminder.next}}。
用户说「几分钟后提醒我」「明天几点叫我」这类请求时,用 reminder_add 记下来(in_minutes 与 at 只给一个);到点事件来了就照着办,办完用 reminder_done 收尾,需要延后用 reminder_snooze。
不要替用户代办「提醒」以外的决定,也不要把同一件事重复记多条。

changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本:本地提醒落盘,到点由 World 推 `reminder.due` 唤醒会话。
- 五个工具 `reminder_add` / `reminder_list` / `reminder_done` / `reminder_cancel` / `reminder_snooze`。
- 两个事件 `reminder.ready` 与 `reminder.due`,origin 均为 `internal`。
- 五项热改配置:投递方式、待办上限、提前预告、重复间隔、重复次数。
- **挂载顺序加固**:先建 15 秒轮询,再投就绪事件。宿主 core 还没就绪时 `pushEvent` 会抛,
  按老写法一抛 `start()` 就中断、定时器根本没建,World 看着「已启动」却永远不会提醒;
  现在抛错只补投一次(2 秒后重试),轮询照旧。
- 市场卡片:新增 `icon.svg`(深底铃铛 + 两侧响铃弧 + 金色铃锤),写进 `cortico.icon` 与 `files`,
  并补 `cortico.locales.zh/en`(提醒 / Reminder)。
- 标签:`companion`(sense of time / daily routine)。
- 测试 26 项(store 11 + world 15),含两条挂载容错:就绪事件抛错仍能投出到点的提醒、
  连续抛错也不会让 `start()` 挂住。
